{{MedalCompetition|[[South American Games]]}} {{MedalGold|[[Basketball at the 2014 South American Games|2014 Chile]]|}} }} '''Luca Vildoza''' (born August 11, 1995) is an Argentine professional basketball player for [[KK Partizan|Partizan Belgrade]] of the [[Basketball League of Serbia|Serbian SuperLeague]], the [[ABA League]], and the [[EuroLeague]]. He also represents the [[Argentina men's national basketball team|Argentine national team]] in international competition. At {{height|m=1.91}} tall, he plays at both the [[point guard]] and [[shooting guard]] positions. ==Professional career== ===Quilmes (2012–2017)=== Vildoza began his career with the [[Liga Nacional de Básquet|Argentine 1st Division]] (LNB) club [[Quilmes de Mar del Plata|Quilmes]], in the [[2011–12 Liga Nacional de Básquet season|2011–12 LNB season]]. He then played in the [[Torneo Nacional de Ascenso|Argentine 2nd Division]] with Quilmes during the TNA 2012–13 season. He spent the next three seasons playing in the top-tier level Argentine League with Quilmes. ===Baskonia (2016–2021)=== In 2016, Vildoza signed a four-year contract with the [[Liga ACB]] club [[Saski Baskonia|Baskonia]]. However, Baskonia [[loan (sports)|loaned]] him back to Quilmes for the [[2016–17 Liga Nacional de Básquet season|2016–17 season]]{{cite web|title=Luca Vildoza new player for Laboral Kutxa Baskonia|url=https://www.baskonia.com/en/luca-vildoza-new-player-for-laboral-kutxa-baskonia/|date=16 August 2016|website=Baskonia.com|accessdate=16 August 2016}} where he averaged 16.9 points and 3.9 assists per game. He rejoined Baskonia for the 2017–18 season and made a debut in the [[2017–18 EuroLeague|EuroLeague]]. Over 24 EuroLeague games, he averaged 4.5 points, 2 assists, and 1.3 rebounds per game. In the [[2017–18 ACB season|Liga ACB]], he appeared in 25 games and averaged 5.9 points while shooting 50% from the field goal and 40.4% from the three-point line.{{cite web|title=Luca Vildoza Player Profile|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Luca-Vildoza/Summary/40899|website=RealGM.com|accessdate=28 April 2021}} Baskonia made the [[2018 ACB Playoffs#Finals|ACB Playoffs Finals]] that season and lost the final 3–1 to [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]]. In the 2018–19 season, Vildoza's role in the team increased, and so did his stats, as he averaged 9.1 points and 3.8 assists over 34 games of the EuroLeague. In March 2019, Vildoza signed a contract extension with Baskonia to stay until the end of 2023–24 season.{{cite news |title=Baskonia, Vildoza together til 2024!|url=https://www.euroleague.net/news/i/9idkgv4uomtlqgal/baskonia-vildoza-together-til-2024|date=6 March 2019|work=euroleague.net|accessdate=10 September 2019}} In the Liga ACB, he appeared in 32 games, averaging 9.3 points per game. In the [[2019 ACB Playoffs#Quarterfinals|ACB Quarterfinals]], Baskonia lost 2–0 to [[Basket Zaragoza|Zaragoza]]. ===Milwaukee Bucks (2022)=== On May 6, 2021, Vildoza signed with the [[New York Knicks]],{{cite web|title=Knicks Sign Luca Vildoza|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/front-office-news/knicks-sign-luca-vildoza|website=NBA.com|date=May 6, 2021|access-date=May 7, 2021}} but was waived on October 3 after playing two [[2021 NBA Summer League]] games.{{cite web|title=Knicks Waive Luca Vildoza|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/knicks-waive-luca-vildoza|website=NBA.com|date=October 3, 2021|access-date=October 3, 2021}} On October 5, Vildoza announced that he had undergone surgery on his right foot.{{cite tweet|author=Luca Vildoza|number=1445454961387589643|title=Hola a todos. Les quiero contar que finalmente hoy me operé del pie derecho, que estoy bien y que apenas los doctores me lo permitan, comenzaré con la recuperación para volver a jugar. Estoy tranquilo. Pasé meses difíciles.|user=LucaVildoza|date=October 5, 2021|access-date=October 5, 2021|language=Spanish}} On April 6, 2022, Vildoza was signed by the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] to a reported two-year contract.{{cite web|title=Milwaukee Bucks Sign Luca Vildoza|url=https://www.nba.com/bucks/news/milwaukee-bucks-sign-luca-vildoza|website=NBA.com|date=April 6, 2022|access-date=April 6, 2022}}{{cite web|first=Adrian|last=Wojnarowski|title=Guard Luca Vildoza expected to sign with Milwaukee Bucks, sources say|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/33671850/guard-luca-vildoza-expected-sign-milwaukee-bucks-sources-say|website=ESPN.com|date=April 4, 2022|access-date=April 6, 2022}} On April 22, Vildoza made his NBA debut in game three of a first-round [[2022 NBA Playoffs|playoff]] series against the [[2021–22 Chicago Bulls season|Chicago Bulls]].{{cite web|title=Game 3 Rapid Recap|url=https://www.brewhoop.com/2022/4/22/23038147/game-3-rapid-recap-bucks-bulls-final-score-nba-playoffs-april-22-2022|website=BrewHoop.com|date=April 22, 2022|access-date=April 22, 2022}} Vildoza was subbed in during the fourth quarter at the 8:02 mark. Vildoza made a three-point shot, grabbed a rebound, recorded two assists, and recorded two steals as the Bucks won 111–81.{{cite web|title=Bucks use balanced attack to cruise past Bulls in Game 3|url=https://www.nba.com/game/mil-vs-chi-0042100123/box-score|website=NBA.com|date=April 22, 2022|access-date=April 22, 2022}} On July 5, he was waived by the Bucks.{{Cite magazine |title=The Milwaukee Bucks Have Waived 2 Players |url=https://www.si.com/fannation/nba/fastbreak/news/the-milwaukee-bucks-have-waived-2-players-the-bucks-lost-in-the-playoffs-to-the-boston-celtics |access-date=July 5, 2022 |magazine=Sports Illustrated}} On July 9, the Bucks re-signed Vildoza to an [[NBA salary cap#Exhibit 10|Exhibit 10 contract]].{{Cite web |title=Bucks Re-Sign Rayjon Tucker, Luca Vildoza To Camp Contracts |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/wiretap/267876/Bucks-Re-Sign-Rayjon-Tucker-Luca-Vildoza-To-Camp-Contracts |access-date=2022-07-12 |website=basketball.realgm.com}} ===Crvena zvezda (2022–2023)=== On October 14, 2022, Vildoza was signed by [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda mts]] of the [[ABA League|Adriatic League]] and the [[EuroLeague]] to a reported two-year contract.{{cite web |title=Luca Vildoza is the new reinforcement of Crvena zvezda mts |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/news/47414/luca-vildoza-is-the-new-reinforcement-of-crvena-zvezda-mts/ |website=aba-liga.com |access-date=14 October 2022}} At the end of the month, he received the [[ABA League Player of the Month Award]].{{cite web|title=NLB MVP OF OCTOBER: LUCA VILDOZA (CRVENA ZVEZDA MTS) |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/news/47594/nlb-mvp-of-october-luca-vildoza-(crvena-zvezda-mts)/ |website=aba-liga.com |access-date=2 November 2022}} In 29 EuroLeague games (24 starts), he averaged 12.6 points, 2.5 rebounds, 3.9 assists, 1.4 steals and 2.6 turnovers, playing around 24 minutes per contest. ===Panathinaikos (2023–2024)=== On June 26, 2023, Vildoza signed a three-year contract with Greek powerhouse [[Panathinaikos B.C.|Panathinaikos]].{{cite web|title=Panathinaikos signs playmaker Luca Vildoza|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/panathinaikos-signs-playmaker-luca-vildoza/|publisher=[[EuroLeague]]|date=26 June 2023|access-date=27 June 2023}} On July 2, 2024, Vildoza amicably parted ways with Panathinaikos, having lifted both the domestic championship as well as the [[EuroLeague]] title for the first time in his career. ===Olympiacos (2024–2025)=== On July 2, 2024, Vildoza signed a two-year deal with [[Greek Basket League]] runner-ups and [[EuroLeague]] bronze medalists [[Olympiacos B.C.|Olympiacos]]. On June 25, 2025, he was released from the Greek club. ===Virtus Bologna (2025–2026)=== On June 25, 2025, Vildoza signed a three-year deal with [[Virtus Bologna]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA) and the EuroLeague.[https://www.virtus.it/news/benvenuto-luca-vildoza/ Benvenuto Luca Vildoza!]. Benvenuto Luca Vildoza! ===Partizan (2026–present)=== On July 26, 2026, Vildoza signed a two-year deal with [[KK Partizan|Partizan]] of the [[Basketball League of Serbia|Serbian SuperLeague]], the [[ABA League]], and the [[EuroLeague]].{{Cite news|title=Luka Vildoza je novi košarkaš Partizana Mozzart Bet|url=https://partizan.basketball/vesti/aktuelno/4228|website=partizan.basketball|date=July 26, 2026|access-date=July 26, 2026|language=sr}} ==National team career== Vildoza was a member of the junior national teams of Argentina. He played with Argentina's junior national team at the [[2012 FIBA Under-17 World Championship|2012 FIBA Under-17 World Cup]]. He is also a member of the senior men's [[Argentina national basketball team|Argentine national basketball team]]. With Argentina's senior team, he has played at the [[Basketball at the 2014 South American Games|2014 ODESUR Games]], the [[Basketball at the 2015 Pan American Games – Men's tournament|2015 Pan American Games]], the [[2016 South American Basketball Championship|2016 South American Championship]], and the [[2017 FIBA AmeriCup]].{{cite web|title=Luca VILDOZA (ARG)|url=https://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/p/rpp//q/luca%20vildoza/pid//_//players.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170825233339/http://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/p/rpp//q/luca%20vildoza/pid//_//players.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=August 25, 2017|website=FIBA.com|accessdate=28 April 2021}} In 2019, Vildoza took part in the team that won the [[Basketball at the 2019 Pan American Games – Men's tournament|Pan American gold medal in Lima]]. Vildoza was included in the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup squads|Argentine squad]] for the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup]] and clinched the silver medal with Argentina, which emerged as runners-up to Spain at the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup]].{{cite web|title=Spain seal second FIBA World Cup with win over Argentina|url=https://www.marca.com/en/more-sports/2019/09/15/5d7e4cf846163f8f878b45d0.html|date=15 September 2019|website=MARCA.com|language=en|accessdate=19 September 2019}} ==Career statistics== {{Euroleague player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== ====Playoffs==== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2022 NBA playoffs|2022]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2021–22 Milwaukee Bucks season|Milwaukee]] | 7 || 0 || 2.4 || .333 || .200 || {{sort|-|—}} || .3 || .6 || .3 || {{sort|-|—}} || .7 |- class="sortbottom" | style="text-align:center;" colspan="2"| Career | 7 || 0 || 2.4 || .333 || .200 || {{sort|-|—}} || .3 || .6 || .3 || {{sort|-|—}} || .7 {{S-end}} ===EuroLeague=== {| class="wikitable" |- | style="background:#AFE6BA;
